title: Refactor Reward Function
description:
Refactor reward function to fix reward farming while maintaining guidance:
1. **Milestone Reward**: Change `at_goal_pos` reward to be ONE-TIME only (triggered upon first entry).
2. **Terminal Reward**: Grant remaining reward only on full success (pos+yaw+stop).
3. **Cleanup**: Remove redundant `displacement_reward` (keep `progress_reward`).

title: Fix LaserScan Initialization
description: Initialize self.scan with large values (e.g., 10.0 or 100.0) instead of zeros to prevent false collision detection (reward penalty) before the first scan callback is received.

title: Add Distance Penalty
description: Add an absolute distance penalty term to the reward function so that being far from the goal incurs a continuous penalty.
